name: Simon Kimbangu
contribution: A Congolese religious leader who founded the Christian new religious movement Kimbanguism.

checks.lead: Simon Kimbangu (September 12, 1887 – October 12, 1951) was a Congolese religious leader who founded the Christian new religious movement Kimbanguism. Kimbanguists consider him to be an incarnation of the Holy Spirit.
